channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dillon Brooks | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dillon Brooks from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Norman Powell on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Norman Powell on Dillon Brooks:

“We know what Dillon does, we know his antics. We know what he tries to do... I didn't feed into it for majority of the game of him trying to bump, foul, hold, talk. I just ignore him but when you push me thats my line in the sand but Bam had to hold me”

Norman Powell on Dillon Brooks, Jan 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Dillon Brooks, DeMarcus Cousins, Austin Reaves, Mat Ishbia
item.description:
Suns coach Suns coach Jordan Ott on team owner Mat Ishbia shooting down former NBA player DeMarcus Cousins suggesting Lakers trading Austin Reaves for Dillon Brooks:

“I have zero social media impact. We love Dillon. We had a big game last night. A big basketball game that we played. Loved that one. We’ve got another challenge tonight.”

Jordan Ott on Dillon Brooks, DeMarcus Cousins, Austin Reaves, Mat Ishbia, Jan 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
“Wr love Dillon. We love what he brings each and every night. His incredible energy is super unique. What he brings to our group is all about winning. That's what he's about.”

Jordan Ott on Dillon Brooks, Dec 20, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Devin Booker on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
“I love to see it. People always say everything’s too friendly in the NBA, and then Dillon comes around and now it’s too much. I’d rather it be too much.”

Devin Booker on Dillon Brooks, Dec 15, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Devin Booker on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Devin Booker on Dillon Brooks:

“He called me immediately I think the day the trade went down...the guy you hate when he's not on your team but you embrace him when he is. I think that whole reputation has taken away from what type of player he really is and how effective he is”

Devin Booker on Dillon Brooks, Sep 24, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Jordan Ott on Dillon Brooks:

“His work ethic backs it up. He's not all smoke. One of the hardest workers I've seen. He lifts our group”

Jordan Ott on Dillon Brooks, Sep 24, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Kevin Durant, Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Ishbia:

“We made the Kevin Durant trade, Dillon was a target. Dillon is exactly what we're talking about. He's the kind of guy we want here. Defensive minded, tough, sticks up for his teammates”

Mat Ishbia on Kevin Durant, Dillon Brooks, Sep 24, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Dillon Brooks, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Warriors coach Steve Kerr on the Rockets:

“Athleticism. Defense. They have an identity. Ime's done a great job establishing who they are. They've got a lot of great athletes, several years in a row in the lottery. They've put together a really good roster, good free agent signings with VanVleet and Brooks. Formidable team, for sure.”

Steve Kerr on Dillon Brooks, Fred VanVleet, Apr 6, 2025. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Anthony Edwards:

“Everybody know how Dillon Brooks is, man. He play dirty. He’s a competitor. I love the competing part, but all the little slick little dirty shit…”

Anthony Edwards on Dillon Brooks, Feb 7, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jeremy Sochan on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Jeremy Sochan on Dillon Brooks:

“He’s all right, a little crazy. But I respect that. He goes hard on defense. He’s kind of one of those players who doesn’t care what other people think, so I respect that too. So, yeah, he’s a pretty good player.”

Jeremy Sochan on Dillon Brooks, Oct 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Ime Udoka on Dillon Brooks:

“I think he made his name on the defensive side, so that's kind of second nature to him. I don't think he's the happiest when he doesn't score, but he's a guy that understands the challenge and took pride in wanting that matchup (Wemby) last night, really pushing him out of his spots and taking him out of his comfort zone.”

Ime Udoka on Dillon Brooks, Mar 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
“It's not a safe play. Guys get hurt like that. And you got to know what type of player [Brooks] is. [The referees] kind of let that just keep going on and [Brooks] kind of provoked it. He talks and says whatever he wants to the refs, to players and at the end of the day, we're men.”

Anthony Davis on Dillon Brooks, Jan 30, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Rui Hachimura on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Lakers forward Rui Hachimura said.

“But I know they’ve been doing it for a while now, especially last year in the playoffs. “For Bron, it’s nothing. It’s actually good for him. He needs that motivation. So, it actually brings him more to the game. Dillon Brooks, he just wants to be part of it — his legacy, I guess.”

Rui Hachimura on Dillon Brooks, Nov 20, 2023. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Dillon Brooks, Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Donatas Urbonas:Jordi Fernandez on Dillon Brooks:

“I'm really proud of Dillon. This is how it looks when they let Dillon Brooks play. And it's just not about the defensive end. With Lu Dort, he's the best perimeter in the World Cup. But he's also extremely efficient offensively.”

Jordi Fernandez on Dillon Brooks, Luguentz Dort, Sep 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @Urbodo.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Luka Doncic when asked about Dillon Brooks:

“I think Dillon played great, he was very physical like he always does. A lot of people don't like him but I respect him for what he does and he does that stuff really good.”

Luka Doncic on Dillon Brooks, Sep 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @vivekmjacob.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Dillon Brooks, Ja Morant
item.description:
After all, it made Brooks look like he’s avoiding the consequences of his actions.

“If you’re not going to talk to the media after two straight games, that to me is cowardice. And I don’t believe either [Ja Morant and Dillon Brooks] are cowards… After talking the talk— you can’t avoid the media,”

Richard Jefferson on Dillon Brooks, Ja Morant, Apr 26, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Ja Morant on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
HoopsHype:Ja Morant:

“If you look at the play, (Dillon Brooks) was actually reaching for the ball on the crossover. LeBron just went behind the back. Obviously got hit somewhere, it's tough for a man.”

Ja Morant on Dillon Brooks, Apr 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: Ja Morant on LeBron James, Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Ja Morant on a possible suspension for Dillon Brooks:

“With how they treat Dillon, I honestly wouldn’t be surprised if he is. I felt like he was ejected because of past ejections made in games before. If you look at the play, he was actually reaching for the ball on a crossover. LeBron just went behind the back.”

Ja Morant on LeBron James, Dillon Brooks, Apr 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: LeBron James on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
LeBron on reacting to the Brooks ejection:

“Just focusing on the game plan. There was a lot of game to be played when that incident happened. So just tried to get up, protect my crown jewels, and move on to the next play.”

LeBron James on Dillon Brooks, Apr 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on LeBron James, Dillon Brooks
item.description:
ClutchPoints: Stephen Jackson on Dillon Brooks:

“I watched a lot of LeBron James games. I've seen a lot of guys just let him score, don't even attempt to guard him. So when I see somebody that's willing to take the challenge to make LeBron earn something, I love it.”

Stephen Jackson on LeBron James, Dillon Brooks, Apr 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Rui Hachimura on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Jovan Buha:Rui Hachimura on Dillon Brooks’ comments:

“That’s all they can do. They’re a young team. They want to talk. We don’t care.”

Rui Hachimura on Dillon Brooks, Apr 21, 2023. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Draymond Green on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
podcast, Green talked about his ongoing feud with Brooks.

“I try to teach guys, and I've had conversations with Dillon Brooks telling him what he needs to do,”

Draymond Green on Dillon Brooks, Apr 11, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Theo Pinson on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Theo Pinson on Dillon Brooks’ comments:

“If I had the same opportunity I’m pretty sure I could do what you do, or better.”

Theo Pinson on Dillon Brooks, Mar 23, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Thompson told The Commercial Appeal.

“When he retires, I don't think anyone will ever talk about Dillon Brooks ever again. I promise you. It's sweet right now, but wait 10 years.”

Klay Thompson on Dillon Brooks, Mar 19, 2023. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Draymond Green on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Draymond Green on that moment with Dillon Brooks toward the end of the first half:

“He thought he would bait me like he gets baited. I get technical fouls when I want to get technical fouls, I don't get baited into technical fouls.”

Draymond Green on Dillon Brooks, Mar 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @madkenney.

item.title: Taylor Jenkins on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Drew Hill:Taylor Jenkins on Dillon Brooks walking the edge:

“He and I talk about it. I won’t go into full detail because I want to keep that stuff private. I always tell him to keep that competitive edge,because that’s what makes him special. When there’s opportunity teach him and grow. We have great honest dialogue where he knows he can stretch us too far or he’s gotta do more.”

Taylor Jenkins on Dillon Brooks, Feb 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
#Cavs Donovan Mitchell on Dillon Brooks:

“A line has to be drawn. The NBA has to do something about it. I’m not the only person this has happened to and there’s no place for that in this game. ... If you just can’t guard somebody, then just say that. Just get a switch.”

Donovan Mitchell on Dillon Brooks, Feb 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
#Cavs Donovan Mitchell on Dillon Brooks:

“That’s just who he is. I’ve been busting his ass for years. Playoffs. Regular season. And the one game he does an alright job on me today, he decides to do something like that. No place for that in the game. Gotta protect yourself.”

Donovan Mitchell on Dillon Brooks, Feb 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Ja Morant on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Ja Morant on Dillon Brooks:

“He puts everything into the game of basketball when he's out there on the floor. He's always going to give you his all. I feel like people kind of misjudge him with that. Any coach would want a player who is going to leave it out there every time.”

Ja Morant on Dillon Brooks, Jan 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @DamichaelC.

item.title: Mike Conley on Dillon Brooks
item.description:
Mike Conley on Dillon Brooks, his teammate for two seasons:

“Man, Dillon obviously plays with a lot of passion. That’s the word I use. You either like it or you don’t. When you’re his teammate, you love it. When you play against him, you hate it. But he was unreal tonight.”

Mike Conley on Dillon Brooks, May 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.
